title: Daily weather at the field station
description: Daily highest and lowest air temperature, rainfall and mean wind speed at an invented field station for the first three weeks of June 2024. Every value is invented.
archive:methods: An automatic station logged every ten minutes; the daily values are the highest and lowest temperature, the summed rainfall and the mean wind speed of each day's readings.
